bvTitel.berichtsheftvorlage_als_pdf: Training log template as a PDF

bvLede.der_vordruck_den_die_meisten: The form most IHK chambers hand out: weekly or daily, with a cover sheet. Enter your name and it appears on every sheet. Free, no sign-up, the PDF is created in your browser.

bvWeiterT.keine_lust_jede_woche_zu: Don’t feel like typing every week?

bvWeiterP.im_berichtsheft_von_myworklog_erzaehlst: In the MyWorkLog training log you describe what happened during the week, and the assistant writes the entry. You end up with the same form as a PDF, digitally signed off by your trainer if you like.

bvWeiterK.berichtsheft_mit_ki_schreiben: Write your training log with AI

bvInhaltT.was_ins_berichtsheft_gehoert: What goes into the training log

bvInhaltP.der_ausbildungsnachweis_gibt_mindestens_: The training log (Ausbildungsnachweis) records, at least in keywords, what you did during your training. Every sheet carries your name, the training year and the period. The content has three blocks:

bvInhalt1.woran_du_gearbeitet_hast_mit: what you worked on, with hours.

bvInhalt2.was_dir_gezeigt_oder_beigebracht: what you were shown or taught.

bvBeispieleL.beispielwochen_fuer_deinen_ausbildungsbe: See example weeks for your occupation

bvKammernT.welche_vorlage_nimmt_meine_ihk: Which template does my IHK use?

bvKammernP.es_gibt_nicht_ein_formular: There is not one form per chamber but three families. Most IHKs hand out the DIHK standard unchanged. The IHKs in Cologne and Frankfurt am Main use a revised version with a field for the training department and two signatures, the IHK for Munich and Upper Bavaria its own header without an hours column. Whether your chamber requires something else is stated on its website or in your training contract.

bvF1.muss_das_berichtsheft_handschriftlich_ge: Does the training log have to be handwritten?
bvF1.nein_seit_2020_darf_der: No. Since 2020 the training log may be kept in writing or electronically (Section 13 sentence 2 no. 7 BBiG). Which form applies is stated in your training contract (Section 11 (1) sentence 2 no. 10 BBiG).

bvF2.darf_ich_das_berichtsheft_waehrend: May I write the training log during working hours?

bvF2a.ja_der_betrieb_muss_dir: Yes. Your company must give you the opportunity to keep the training log at your workplace (Section 14 (2) sentence 2 BBiG).

bvF2l.was_du_tun_kannst_wenn: What you can do if you are told to write it at home

bvF3.woechentlich_oder_taeglich_welche_vorlag: Weekly or daily – which template do I need?
bvF3.der_ausbildungsnachweis_ist_mindestens_w: The training log has to be kept at least weekly. Use the daily template if your company or chamber requires it.

bvF4a.du_selbst_und_dein_ausbilder: You and your trainer. The company must review your records regularly (Section 14 (1) no. 4 BBiG); the DIHK form says “at least monthly”.

bvF5.was_passiert_wenn_das_berichtsheft: What happens if the training log is missing?
bvF5.ohne_ordnungsgemaess_gefuehrten_ausbildu: Without a properly kept training log you will not be admitted to the final exam (Section 43 (1) no. 2 BBiG).

bvF6.nein_das_pdf_entsteht_in: No. The PDF is created in your browser, without an account and without your details being sent to a server.
